scripture.verse: "Ye are not your own: for ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's."
"Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house. The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats, and the rooks for the conies."
"I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, keep not back."
"We love him because he first loved us."
"As soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children."

sermons.title: Sermon 1010 | Light for Those Who Sit in Darkness

scripture.verse: "The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles; the people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up,"

sermons.title: Sermon 1011 | Job's Regret and Our Own

scripture.verse: "Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me when his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness; as I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle."
"He that believed, not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him."
